# SmolVLM2: Bringing Video Understanding to Every Device
## Technical Details
The 2.2B model is the go-to choice for vision and video tasks, while the 500M and 256M models represent **the smallest video language models ever released**.

While they're small in size, they outperform any existing models per memory consumption.
